create.name: Tibethaus Deutschland
create.bio:
Tibethaus Deutschland is a Tibetan Buddhist cultural and educational institute in Frankfurt am Main, with the Dalai Lama as its patron. It grew out of Chödzong, a Buddhist centre in Franconia that ran for more than twenty years under Dagyab Rinpoche, a Tibetan scholar based in Berlin who once headed the first Tibet House in Delhi; from 2005 the work was rebuilt in Frankfurt as a Tibethaus, one of only two outside India recognised by the Tibet House cultural centre in New Delhi, the other being Tibet House US. In 2017 the association moved into its own late nineteenth-century villa near the city's trade fair grounds. Dagyab Rinpoche remains its spiritual guide, joined by the young Geshe Lharampa Zong Rinpoche.

Its programme runs to roughly 350 evening classes, seminars, workshops and talks a year across Buddhism, Tibetan art and culture, personal development and dialogue with science, many of them streamed live. Structured study programmes in German include a long-term Buddhist training, a reading course on classic Buddhist texts and a Christian-Buddhist dialogue forum, alongside open meditation evenings in the house. The YouTube channel keeps German-language teachings by Dagyab Rinpoche, Dalai Lama teachings rendered in German from 2020 and recent talks by visiting Tibetan teachers, several interpreted into German.

Health rule: the institute also has a Tibetan medicine (Heilkunde) area; left out of the bio and items.
